jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer, Growth
jobs.description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>Our Growth team is on a mission to acquire, convert, and grow millions of merchants globally across the full Stripe suite of financial products. We're a cross-functional team of engineers, scientists, marketers, designers, and product managers that deliver the insights, algorithms, internal systems and tools, and user-facing experiences that fuel our growth. We help businesses around the world find Stripe, get started, and grow.</p> <p>As part of the Growth Engineering team, you'll build the systems, products, internal tools, and customer-facing experiences that power intelligence behind our go-to-market and product-led growth. This includes building ML-powered recommendations and growth experimentation engines, multi-channel notification systems, and key growth-related customer experiences (e.g., onboarding flows, user dashboards, product recommendations).</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>As a full-stack engineer on the Growth team, you'll build and ship experiments and product improvements across stripe.com and the Dashboard to help businesses find and get started on Stripe. You'll work on critical parts of the funnel for self-serve users, ensuring their experience on Stripe is consistently high-quality. With other engineers and data scientists, you'll turn ML-powered recommendations, messaging, and experimentation into impact that moves company metrics.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Build and maintain scalable systems and customer experiences that help businesses discover, onboard, and grow with Stripe products.</li> <li>Develop high-quality, robust backend APIs in Ruby that power responsive frontend experiences using React, JavaScript, and CSS.</li> <li>Implement and iterate on ML-driven recommendations, experimentation frameworks, and growth optimization features.</li> <li>Work with data scientists and product managers to translate growth hypotheses into technical implementations and A/B tests.</li> <li>Contribute to shared platforms and tools that enable rapid experimentation across growth initiatives.</li> <li>Debug production issues across the full stack and participate in on-call rotations.</li> <li>Write maintainable, well-tested code that follows t

jobs.title: SAP Consolidations Manager, International Accounting
jobs.description: <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">GAQ327R292</p> <p>We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve - leveraging AI, automation, and modern tooling to operate at the pace Databricks demands. We are looking for two <strong>Consolidations Managers</strong> to join our <strong>Global Accounting team</strong> based in India. These are <strong>foundational hires</strong> - you will own the end-to-end consolidation and intercompany accounting process across Databricks' 23-entity global footprint, build deep SAP Group Reporting expertise during our S/4HANA implementation, and establish the permanent organisational capability that scales with the business post go-live.</p> <p>This role blends hands-on consolidation execution with technical accounting judgment. As part of the Global Accounting organisation, you will ensure the accurate and timely production of consolidated financial statements under both US GAAP and IFRS, while partnering closely with International Accounting, Corporate Accounting, Tax, and FP&amp;A to drive close integrity across all reporting frameworks.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2006"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">The impact you will have: </strong></p> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2006">Own and execute the global consolidation process end-to-end - intercompany reconciliation, elimination entries, currency translation, and multi-entity roll-up across our 23-entity footprint.</li> <li>Lead multi-GAAP close execution, producing parallel US GAAP and IFRS consolidated books each period, identifying and documenting reconciling differences for audit and leadership review.</li> <li>Build and own SAP Group Reporting expertise - serve as the accounting team's subject matter expert on SAP's consolidation engine, including configuration, period-end processing, and ongoing optimisation.</li> <li>Execute intercompany accounting across all entities - ensuring balances are reconciled, disputes are resolved within the close window, and elimination entries are complete and accurate.</li> <li>Perform monthly consolidation flux analysis, identifying and clearly articulating drivers behind significant period-over-period movements for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.</li> <li>Own FX translation and revaluation accounting - functional currency determination, translation adjustments, and CTA reconciliation across all international entities.</li> <li>Support new entity stand-up - partner with Tax, Legal, and International Accounting to establish consolidation processes, intercompany agreements, and reporting structures for new international selling entities as Databricks expands.</li> <li>Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external audit on consolidation, int
